newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: UK's Major to "play it long" on election.
newsitem.headline: UK's Major to "play it long" on election.

text.p: British Prime Minister John Major said on Tuesday he was ready to "play it long" on the election, reinforcing growing belief that he intends to go to the wire and wait until May 1 to hold the election.
But he said the Conservative party was "ready for the elction whenever it comes".
Major was speaking before leaving Pakistan at the end of a week-long south Asian trip.
His departure was brought forward to ensure that he, trade secretary Ian Lang and Conservative MP and campaign strategist Alan Duncan could make Tuesday night's crucial vote on the finance bill.
